capabilities: Group notes into board columns and rows
Drag cards between groups to update note properties
Create notes in groups with pre-filled properties
Color-code groups and show property-based images and icons on cards
extras: Not yet added to the Obsidian community plugin directory (under review); currently installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Interactive Board view for bases, use as Kanban or Gallery
motivation: The author needed both column and row grouping, which he says almost never gets added, and building it was fun.
problem: Obsidian's Bases views have no interactive board layout, so notes cannot be grouped by properties and moved between groups by dragging.
summary: Bases view that displays notes as an interactive Kanban or Gallery board with row and column grouping and drag-and-drop.
